title: Variable Properties: Naming, Types, Labels, and Values

content.quick: Variable View in SPSS defines how the software interprets your questionnaire responses. Variable names cannot start with numbers or contain spaces; labels provide full survey text; value labels map numeric codes to categories; and measurement scales govern which statistical tests SPSS allows you to run.

sentences.text: Correctly configuring variable properties in SPSS prevents catastrophic syntax errors and miscalculated statistical tests.
sentences.simple: Setting up your variable settings in SPSS properly stops mistakes before you run any calculations.
sentences.plain: Correctly configuring variable properties in SPSS prevents catastrophic syntax errors and miscalculated statistical tests.
sentences.technical: Proper variable parameterization within the SPSS data dictionary establishes mathematical constraints essential for parametric test validity.

questions.q: Which of the following is an INVALID variable name in SPSS?
